text:
Predicates:
Nice(x) ::: x is nice to animals.
Mean(x) ::: x is mean to animals.
Grumpy(x) ::: x is a grumpy person.
LovesAnimals(x) ::: x loves animals.
OwnsPet(x) ::: x owns a pet.
Premises:
∀x (Nice(x) → ¬Mean(x)) ::: No one nice to animals is mean to animals.
∃x (Grumpy(x) ∧ Mean(x)) ::: Some grumpy people are mean to animals.
∀x (LovesAnimals(x) → Nice(x)) ::: All animal lovers are nice to animals.
∀x (OwnsPet(x) → LovesAnimals(x)) ::: If someone owns a pet, then they love animals.
OwnsPet(tom) ::: Tom is a pet owner.
Conclusion:
Grumpy(tom) ::: Tom is a grumpy person.
